newsitem.title: UK: Hitachi Finance UK plans $150 mln Eurobond - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi Finance UK plans $150 mln Eurobond - dealers.

text.p: Hitachi Finance UK plans to issue a $150 million three-year Eurobond this week, bankers said on Tuesday.
The deal was expected to pay between eight and 10 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes. Bankers said Hitachi Finance UK was a triple-A rated entity.
Goldman Sachs and IBJ International were tipped as joint lead managers, but officials there were not immediately available for comment.
Last October, Hitachi Credit Corp, rated A1 by Moody's and AA by Standard & Poor's, launched a $200 million five-year bond at 34 basis points over Treasuries via J.P. Morgan.
